It’s time for some more FACT vs FICTION on the One Big Beautiful Bill. 

Today, let’s talk about Medicaid, and how we’re strengthening it for Americans who need it and qualify for it ⬇️ https://t.co/nn0BzAaK02

The media won’t say it, but here’s the truth: 

We’re protecting Medicare and Social Security, cracking down on fraud, and making sure that safety nets like Medicaid and SNAP are there for those who truly need it.

The One Big Beautiful Bill is common sense. Here’s why ⬇️ https://t.co/P64AQJS1mP

When I was President of the Florida Senate, we successfully REFORMED Medicaid in our state, so I know a thing or two about how this program works. 

Let me push back on some of the outright LIES that Democrats are scaring people with about the One Big Beautiful Bill ⬇️ https://t.co/JSTo2Rgwno
ICYMI: My recent op-ed in @Florida_Today showing the truth about how the One Big Beautiful Bill strengthens Medicaid and CHIP for those who truly need it and qualify for it ⬇️ https://t.co/ty0N9dOMFx

Florida Republicans are sending a clear message:

✅ End taxes on tips
✅ Stop the largest tax hike in history
✅ Secure our border
✅ Protect Medicaid for the truly vulnerable

That’s what the One Big Beautiful Bill does.

Let’s get it to the president’s desk!

I have a suggestion for my Democrat colleagues: Read the bill before you lie about it!

This bill doesn’t cut Medicaid for the vulnerable, it protects it.

It doesn’t cut taxes for billionaires either, it cuts taxes for WORKING Americans.

That’s why I’m proud to support it. https://t.co/KTaFurVYji

The One Big Beautiful Bill just PASSED.

✅ Protecting Social Security & Medicare
✅ Cracking down on fraud & abuse
✅ Funding border security
✅ Cutting taxes for those who earned it

We kept our promises. Now it heads to President Trump’s desk! https://t.co/W2qRY6H4Zc

Fact Check: The Big Beautiful Bill has NO cuts to Medicaid for vulnerable Americans like pregnant women, the disabled, low-income kids, or nursing home residents. 

It’s spelled out in the bill: We’re safeguarding care for the people who need it, while asking able-bodied adults to meet basic work requirements.

That’s how we make the system sustainable and fair.

If you’re having trouble with a federal agency, my office is here to help.

My team can help with:
✔️ Veterans Affairs
✔️ Social Security
✔️ Medicare
✔️ IRS
✔️ Immigration Services
✔️ and more

We’ve already helped over a thousand Floridians this year alone. Reach out on my website today!

When people find out what’s actually in the One Big Beautiful Bill, they like it:
Lower taxes.
A secure border.
Stronger manufacturing.
And no cuts to the vulnerable on Medicaid.

When Americans see the results, they’ll know who had their back. https://t.co/XEtYiC0haM

It was an honor to join the VA Town Hall in Brevard County this week. The event brought together veterans, families, and local VA leaders for a resource fair and a leadership panel focused on VA healthcare and benefits.

I joined Orlando VA Director Timothy Cooke and Dr. Brandan Wormsbacher for the discussion, where we heard directly from veterans about their concerns and ideas. Hearing directly from our veterans ensures we continue improving the care and services they depend on. Thank you to everyone who came out to make your voices heard!
Read more here: https://t.co/lxjE4PvwNS

Thanks to @Schilling1776 for having me on to talk about what it’s like serving in Congress today.

We covered everything from keeping America space dominant, to tax cuts and Medicaid reforms, to how my LEDGER Act will bring transparency to Washington.

Give it a listen!
Thanks to Congressional Republicans and President Trump, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services just rolled out the LARGEST investment in rural healthcare our nation has ever seen!

I joined @bradleydevlin to discuss why Republicans are standing firm during the shutdown.

Democrats’ “ransom note”? Free health care for non-citizens while Americans foot the $1,500,000,000,000 bill.

Watch the full episode: https://t.co/D8ezuqMXZc

Obamacare promised lower costs and more choice. Instead, it delivered higher prices, fewer doctors, and handouts to insurance companies.

We need to reopen the government and have the debate about healthcare that Americans deserve: One focused on lowering costs, not propping up a broken system.

Each week this shutdown continues, Florida’s housing market grows more unstable, as flood insurance programs are halted, home loans are delayed, and HUD operations are limited.

Democrats are costing Floridian families by continuing this insane shutdown.
